# Macallan Inc

> Macallan Inc is a Wyoming holding company. Our businesses: AccessSmith (website ADA accessibility services) and Chinese astrology (readings, I Ching cards, and a free open library of 2,064 classical texts).

Macallan Inc is a privately held company registered in Sheridan, Wyoming, USA. We run a small portfolio of businesses — each one useful, each one honest. AccessSmith is a service of Macallan Inc.

This website (macallaninc.com) is a single page with three sections: Businesses, About, and Contact.

## Businesses

- [AccessSmith](https://accesssmith.com): Website accessibility (ADA / WCAG 2.1) for US small businesses — audits, remediation, and ongoing monitoring. AccessSmith is a service of Macallan Inc. Contact: hi@accesssmith.com
- [AstrologyLib.com](https://astrologylib.com): Classical Chinese astrology, done by humans — personal BaZi readings and NFC-enabled I Ching card decks, no AI-generated horoscopes.
- [AstrologyLib.org](https://astrologylib.org): A free, open-access, non-profit library of 2,064 classical Chinese texts — the Yijing canon and the Daoist canon — with volunteer translations in progress. No paywall, no donations, just the texts.

## AccessSmith pricing (as listed on macallaninc.com)

- $249 — one-time in-depth accessibility audit with a detailed report
- $29/mo · $79/quarter · $290/yr — ongoing monitoring that alerts you before small issues become legal risk
- Remediation projects for WordPress, Shopify, and custom sites

## Other pricing

- Personal BaZi reading — $39.99 on Etsy
- NFC I Ching cards — tap a card, read the hexagram (Kickstarter coming soon)

- [Contact](https://macallaninc.com/#contact): How to reach us.
